column1: # CIRIS evidence registry — the `state:blocked-upstream` adoption manifest.
# Each row is an upstream obligation this repo is waiting on, expressed as a
# SCANNABLE PREDICATE: a needle whose appearance in the named tree means the
# obligation landed. A prose note creates an obligation nowhere; a predicate
# creates one a test can read.
# kind: absence  — the needle is absent today; its arrival IS the fix landing
#       drift    — the needle exists but at the wrong count/place
#       untestable — the repo is not in this repo's reachable tree; nothing to scan
# Counts (files/lines) were measured against CIRISConformance origin/main

column9: The daily head recompute (#86 §0). The floor is hand-bumped, so it rots: on 2026-08-16 the pinned ciris-server==0.5.131 was no longer installable from PyPI at all. When a workflow writes or reads matrices/head.yaml, the recompute has landed.

Normative pins as FIELDS (#86 §4 class 3). The Constitution version is tracked in prose inside pin comments (e.g. "CC unchanged (1.0-rc2, commit 5818a75)") and the wire vocabulary lives in a markdown file. grace/substrate.py:normative_pins stays unimplemented until one of these keys exists.

The client lane (#86 §2). run-against-wheels.yml exists and takes under-test-wheel-artifact; the client twin takes an AAR/JAR/XCFramework plus flavor and platform. Its arrival is what lets a client regression turn a consumer tag-run red.
The third marker. conftest.pytest_collection_modifyitems partitions the suite into substrate and fabric; a client tier needs a third. Zero occurrences of the literal today.
